movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Elbows held in front or behind the torso.

signature_moves.description: Dancer bends upper body forward with hips and thighs at a right angle while rhythmically stamping feet.
signature_moves.name: Right-Angle Forward Lean Stamp

basic_steps: Bend upper body forward forming a right angle between hips and thighs
Hold elbows in front or behind the torso
Stamp feet on the ground in a rhythmic pattern for thirty seconds
